description: Schematic map of reported dominant vs recessive CEACAM16 variants across the protein/domain architecture
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

# CEACAM16 human (UniProt Q2WEN9), 425 aa. Domain architecture (approximate, from UniProt/InterPro):
# signal peptide ~1-33; Ig-like V-type 1 (N1) ~34-159; Ig-like C2-type "constant/A" ~168-256;
# Ig-like V-type 2 (N2, most conserved) ~330-420. Boundaries are approximate.
L = 425
domains = [
    ("Signal peptide", 1, 33, "#cccccc"),
    ("Ig V-type 1 (N1)", 34, 159, "#8ecae6"),
    ("Ig C2-type (constant/A)", 160, 256, "#ffb703"),
    ("linker", 257, 329, "#e0e0e0"),
    ("Ig V-type 2 (N2, most conserved)", 330, 420, "#fb8500"),
]

# Reported variants
dom_missense = [("p.Thr140Ile", 140), ("p.Gly169Arg", 169), ("p.Arg255Gly", 255), ("p.Leu365Arg", 365)]
rec_variants = [("p.Arg146Ter (recessive nonsense)", 146)]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.2))
for name,s,e,c in domains:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s,0),e-s,1,facecolor=c,edgecolor="k",lw=0.7))
    if e-s>40:
        ax.text((s+e)/2,0.5,name,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8)

for name,pos in dom_missense:
    ax.annotate(name,(pos,1),xytext=(pos,1.9),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="darkred",
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="darkred"))
for name,pos in rec_variants:
    ax.annotate(name,(pos,0),xytext=(pos,-1.1),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="navy",
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="navy"))

ax.set_xlim(0,L+5); ax.set_ylim(-1.6,2.4); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("Amino acid position (CEACAM16, 425 aa; Q2WEN9)")
ax.set_title("Reported CEACAM16 variants: dominant missense (red, above) vs recessive LoF (blue, below)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("ceacam16_variant_map.png",dpi=140)
print("Dominant missense variant positions:", [p for _,p in dom_missense])
print("Fraction of protein length for each:", [round(p/L,2) for _,p in dom_missense])
print("Recessive nonsense position:", rec_variants[0][1], "-> truncates ~", round((L-146)/L*100), "% of protein")
